findings.quote: According to estimates, as much as 80 per cent of future work will be done using artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI benefits and transformation of work and society.

findings.quote: We need to be better prepared for the challenge of algocracy, including by regulating the impact of artificial intelligence on human rights protection.

findings.quote: The aim of the centre will be to provide an open environment, focusing on the governance and policies surrounding artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Describes a proposed UNESCO-backed AI research centre and governance role.
